verdict.rationale: LibreChat exposes an Agent Management API (beta) with OIDC-authenticated machine clients and Scheduled Chats, plus an OpenAPI spec, suggesting some programmatic/automation capability beyond the chat UI, but there is no documentation of a headless mode, CLI runner, or CI-specific setup guide. Missing for 10: explicit headless/CLI execution mode, CI pipeline examples, and confirmation that the full agent/chat workflow can run without a browser UI.
